overview.description: The Northern Trust iBoxx 5-Year Target Duration TIPS ETF (TDTF) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the iBoxx 5-Year Target Duration TIPS index. The fund tracks an index of inflation-protected US government debt with a targeted duration of roughly five years. TDTF was launched on Sep 19, 2011 and is issued by Northern Trust.
